agent_answer_excerpt:
Active customers are a governed defined class (kp:ActiveCustomer): a customer with at least one order in the last 2 years. I resolve it to its bound measure `is_active_customer` on `customer_order_in_context` rather than writing the membership filter by hand. The 2-year window is anchored to the data's max order date (2024-04-20), not today — so it covers 2022-04-20 through 2024-04-20. Running `run: customer_order_in_context -> { aggregate: is_active_customer }` returns the count.

Basis: kp:ActiveCustomer (governed) | Freshness: 2024-04-20 (last-2-years window anchored to max_date) | Steward: sales
